label: Create table Book
summary: Creates table Book with required columns

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "Book" (
  "author" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "categoryId" CHARACTER NOT NULL,
  "coverData" BLOB,
  "coverType" TEXT,
  "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "description" TEXT,
  "id" CHARACTER NOT NULL,
  "isbn" TEXT,
  "price" REAL NOT NULL,
  "publishedYear" INTEGER,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

postcheck.description: verify table "Book" has exactly its columns

  "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "description" TEXT,
  "id" CHARACTER NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
